headline:
Visa's twin,
slightly cheaper on growth
chart_note: 52-week range: $464.52 - $601.62. Currently around $580, near the top of that range after a strong quarter.
why_today: Near 52-week highs after Q2 EPS beat estimates by nearly 6% - a similar setup to Visa, with a slightly lower PEG ratio.
pro_1: Revenue up 13.8% YoY with a Strong Buy consensus and a beta of just 0.73 - a defensive way to own payments growth
pro_2: PEG ratio of about 1.5x is a touch cheaper on a growth-adjusted basis than its closest peer, Visa
con_1: PE of 31.9x still prices in a lot of good news - not a bargain by any conventional measure
con_2: Only about 3.9% below its 52-week high, so a lot of the near-term upside may already be captured
